# Security Skill

When to Use: During audits, code reviews, or before releases to ensure app hardening.

Workflow Steps:
1. Scan for risky API usage (`bypassSecurityTrust*`).
2. Validate XSRF setup and CORS policies.
3. Recommend CSP headers and Trusted Types integration.

See examples/ and checklists/ for remediation templates.
